summary: BCE Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the Canadian equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing a news release reporting results of its Series S and Series T preferred share conversion privilege. Only 400 Series T shares elected conversion into Series S, and 676,765 Series S shares elected conversion into Series T, effective November 2, 2026, one-for-one. Post-conversion, 5,474,698 Series T and 1,190,512 Series S shares will be outstanding, still listed on the TSX. Series T will pay a fixed 5.523% annual dividend for five years. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping notice, not a special situation; no deal terms, no risk-arb angle.
